update.title: OnlineJudge 1.16.0 Update
details: Updated base image from `python:3.8-alpine3.14` to `python:3.12-alpine`.
Updated judge runtime language versions:
C/C++: GCC 13
Java: Temurin 21
Python 2: removed
Python 3: CPython 3.12
Golang: Golang 1.22
Node.js: Node.js 20
PHP: temporarily removed
Upgraded django-dramatiq to 0.10.0 to fix the database connection leak issue.
Django 2.x is approaching end of support; upgraded Django to 3.x LTS and all related dependencies accordingly.
Merged base image to python:3.8-alpine3.14 in preparation for removing Python 2.
Following the upstream production guideline, switched dependency from psycopg2_binary to psycopg2.
TODO: local development setup docs should be updated and submitted accordingly.
Fixed several issues with Golang compile and run.
Added JavaScript language support. Note: after upgrading you need to run reset_languages as described in the docs; any custom configuration will be reset, so back up first.
Added editor syntax highlighting for additional languages.
Upgraded gcc/g++ compilers to version 9.4.
User import now supports importing real names.
Fixed several KaTeX configuration issues on the frontend.
Fixed an editor bug where tables would not render.
Added editor syntax highlighting for additional languages.
Add Golang language to judge server
Fix some frontend bugs
Fix bugs in contest password verification
Do not delete test case files when contest is deleted
Update some compiler runtime config
Fix bugs in Free Problem Set parser
Fix bugs in judge server scheduler
Update Django to version 2.1 and Python to version 3.7
Replace celery with dramatiq
Add problem file IO Mode
You can add attachments in all editor
You can upload source code file in submission editor
Frontend and UI improvements
Fixed a lot of bugs
